body:
The P3 implementation in development in CloudMicrophysics hard-codes the largest mean ice particle mass of its size distribution and the relaxation timescale of Frostenberg (2023) deposition nucleation. This PR adds both to `parameters.toml`, so that CloudMicrophysics can read them through ClimaParams, and bumps the version to 1.3.4.

New keys:
- `P3_ice_largest_mean_particle_mass` (1e-4 kg): the largest mean ice particle mass of the P3 size distribution.
- `Frostenberg2023_deposition_relaxation_timescale` (300 s): the timescale of the relaxation of deposition nucleation toward the Frostenberg et al. (2023) target concentration.

The activation conditions of that deposition nucleation are the existing keys `P3_cooper_deposition_temperature_threshold` and `P3_cooper_deposition_ice_supersaturation_threshold`. Both new keys are marked experimental. No existing key changes.
title: Add the largest P3 mean ice mass and the Frostenberg 2023 deposition timescale
